rules: Do not tune the associative projection, cue/tag registries, retrieval profile, or scoring rules against this pack and later claim the result is fresh evidence.
Score correct evidence neighborhood and abstention behavior, not exact document rank.
Record cold-cache and warm-cache runs separately for the live-retrieval conditions (A/B/D).
Condition C (associative shadow) is deterministic and offline; it has no cache state.

disclosure.reason: Queries and expected behaviors were authored with knowledge of the E1 fixture corpus (cue/tag registries). A separate fresh verification pack (associative_routing_e1_fresh_verification_pack.json) is required before any improvement claim.
